summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to include penicillin allergy verification and evaluation as part of the initial preventive physical examination and annual wellness visits under Medicare, aiming to identify and re-evaluate reported penicillin allergies in seniors.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts healthcare by expanding the scope of services covered under Medicare's initial preventive physical examination and annual wellness visits to include penicillin allergy verification and evaluation. This aims to improve patient outcomes and antibiotic stewardship, which are core healthcare concerns.

The bill expands Medicare benefits by adding a new service to the initial preventive physical examination and annual wellness visits. Medicare is a significant component of the social safety net, providing healthcare to seniors, so expanding its services constitutes an expansion of welfare in this context.
